 CONFIRMED lineups: Racing Santander vs Real Madrid, 2026 La Liga
 by Lucas Navarrete Nov 1, 2026, 2:35 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Real Madrid have published their starting lineup for the upcoming match against Racing Santander in La Liga. Los Blancos made a statement with their impressive 1-2 win in El Clásico and will want to keep their good form and momentum going against a solid home team like Racing.
 STARTING LINEUPS 
 Racing Santander starting XI (TBC): Agirrezabala; Mantilla, Pablo Ramón, Belocian, Aarón Martín; Iván Martín, Almeida; Pablo García, Canales, Iñigo Vicente; Zabiri
 Real Madrid starting XI: Courtois; Trent, Konaté, Huijsen, Cucurella; Tchouaméni, Bernardo Silva; Güler, Bellingham, Diomande; Mbappé.
 HOW TO WATCH, STREAM LA LIGA 
 Date : 11/01/2026
 Time : 16:15 CET, 10:15am EST.
 Venue : El Sardinero, Santander, Spain.
 Available TV : DAZN La Liga (Spain), ESPN Deportes (USA).
 Available Streaming : ESPN+ (USA)
